stories.title: WCS Game 2 Recap — Padres 4, Cubs 1; Cubs Eliminated
stories.angle: Gausman lasted 3.1 IP (3 ER). Gavin Sheets' pinch-hit 2-run HR was the knockout. Padres bullpen held down the MLB's best offense for 5.2 scoreless innings. Cubs scored 1 run total in 2 WCS games. Season over.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
4-1. Cubs eliminated. 💔

Gausman: 3.1 IP, 3 ER. Gavin Sheets pinch-hit 2-run HR locked it up for San Diego.

The MLB's best offense scored 1 run across both WCS games.

Padres sweep. See you next year.

stories.title: Season Postmortem — MLB-Best Offense, Swept Out in 2 Games
stories.angle: Cubs led MLB in wRC+ (115), runs, OPS (.769), and slugging. Led NL in homers. 89 wins. Then scored 1 run in 2 playoff games. Counsell: "unfulfilled and disappointed." This team was historically unbalanced — October exposed the gap.

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
115 wRC+. Led MLB in runs, OPS, and slugging. 89 wins. 🏆

1 run in 2 playoff games.

Counsell: "We're walking away unfulfilled and disappointed."

Great offense, middling pitching. October exposed the gap. The 2026 Cubs weren't unlucky. They were unbalanced.

#Cubs #GoCubs #MLB

stories.title: PCA — NL MVP Season, WCS Silence
stories.angle: .280/.372/.570, 45 HR, 41 SB, 10.4 fWAR. First 40-40 Cub in franchise history. NL MVP frontrunner by a wide margin. Went hitless in the WCS. PCA: "I'm just feeling pretty disappointed in myself." Both things are true.

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
45 home runs. 41 stolen bases. 10.4 fWAR. 🔥

First 40-40 Cub in franchise history. NL MVP frontrunner.

PCA: "I'm just feeling pretty disappointed in myself."

One bad series doesn't erase 162 games of historic baseball. The MVP vote is coming.

stories.title: Offseason Pitching Crisis — Gausman, Boyd, Holmes All Uncertain
stories.angle: Gausman is a free agent. Boyd's $15M mutual option almost certain to be declined. Holmes has a player option. Cubs could enter November without a guaranteed starting pitcher. Hoyer's biggest offseason challenge.

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Gausman: free agent.
Boyd: $15M mutual option, almost certain to decline.
Holmes: player option, uncertain.

The Cubs could start this offseason without a single locked-in rotation arm.

Hoyer's defining offseason starts now. ⚾
